Title: D3: Migrate LiteDB to SQLite
Content: Decision D3 (locked, 2026-06-01): Migrate LiteDB storage to SQLite with WAL mode, aligning with MemorySmith's pattern. Include DatabaseProviderFactory, migrations-on-startup, and busy timeout config. Current state: LiteDB still in use for AgentEventLog (LiteDbAgentEventLog.cs in Orchestrator.Infrastructure). Migration is planned for Phase C2 (moved up from Phase E after council recommendation). SQLite provides better concurrent access, tooling, and alignment with the codebase's direction.
